'''Moralo Eval''' was a [[Phindian/Legends|Phindian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] criminal mastermind who invented [[Box/Legends|the Box]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Eval masterminded a plot to kidnap [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. Eval fled across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]&mdash;with [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] (disguised as [[Rako Hardeen/Legends|Rako Hardeen]]) and [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]]&mdash;from [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] as wanted fugitives.

==Biography==

=== Early life ===
{{Quote|Your box does not appear to be as much of a challenge as I thought. Perhaps I should put Hardeen in charge of the mission.''"<br />"''But, this was my plan. You promised me the lead role.''"<br />"''You have one last test to change my mind.''"<br />"''Do not fear, Count Dooku. I will show you who is weak.|Count Dooku and Eval discussing who will lead the mission to kidnap Palpatine|<ref name="The Box">{{TCW|The Box}}</ref>}}
Moralo Eval had a loathsome reputation that started when he was a boy when he committed a heartless murder. Eval killed his mother and, when apprehended by the authorities, told them that he killed his [[Moralo Eval's mother/Legends|mother]] because he was "bored". Eval then spent the rest of his life as a criminal and fugitive.

Eval's lifestyle gave him a sharp survival instinct, along with technical and engineering skills. During that time, Eval became deranged and developed many odd mannerisms which included talking about himself in the third person.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

=== The Clone Wars ===
[[File:TheGreatEscape-D.jpg|thumb|left|280px|Eval, Bane, and Hardeen escape from prison.]]During the Clone Wars, rumors surfaced that Eval was plotting to kidnap the Chancellor, despite being in a [[Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center/Legends|Republic jail]].<ref name="Deception">{{TCW|Deception}}</ref>

Sometime while Eval was in [[Prison/Legends|prison]], he befriended [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who was disguised as [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Rako Hardeen/Legends|Rako Hardeen]], in order to stop the [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] plot. Eval, along with fellow inmate [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]], convinced Hardeen to escape the prison together.<ref name="Deception" />

Fleeing the prison, they took a Republic cruiser and crash-landed on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], in order to escape pursuit. Hardeen purchased a new [[Starship/Legends|ship]] for the trio, as their old one was too damaged to fly again. The trio set out once more, this time for [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]] to meet up with [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and pursue the kidnapping plot.

Upon arrival on Serenno, Bane and Kenobi joined the other bounty hunters gathered there and took part in a series of tests devised by Eval. After Bane proved himself the leader that Dooku desired, Eval was relieved of command of the kidnapping mission and relegated to the role of getaway driver.

Ultimately, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] efforts were successful and the plot foiled, and Eval taken back into custody.<ref>{{TCW|Crisis on Naboo}}</ref> Moralo Evan was returned to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and to a military facility from which, held in isolation, even Eval found escape was impossible.<ref>{{FactFile2014|57|EVA 1–2|Moralo Eval}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In the ''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' television series, Moralo Eval was voiced by [[Stephen Stanton]].<ref name="Deception" /> Throughout [[2012]] , Stanton was often a guest on [[The ForceCast]], where he voiced the character in a recurring segment called "Bedtime Stories with Moralo Eval" or "Uncle Moralo's Bedtime Stories".<ref>{{YouTube|video=m823g3Z1SbQ|text=Stephen Stanton and The ForceCact Present Bedtime Stories with Moralo Eval|channel=channel/UCX9blpIcEP0OHWnGtkF0JXQ|name=Taylor Larson}}</ref>
